title: Video2SpriteSheet Tools
author: Sasbe93
selftext: Okay, i am using cursor and i tried my ai generated sprite videos already white background and green background(a big contrast to my sprite) and put it in several video2sprite tools(online and customized with cursor). But each time i am unsatisfied with the result. There are still somewhere backgroundartefacts(customized solutions) or the image is in low quality(online solutions). What is your workflow with this? Or are you creating sprites on a different way(tried the newes image in chatgpt, but even this doesnt made me good sheets)?

comments.author: Celvin_
comments.body: I’ve encountered the same problem. Curious to see if anyone has any workaround for this.

comments.author: EmotionalFan5429
comments.body: You may try my solution: [https://github.com/unreal79/Chromakey-video-to-image](https://github.com/unreal79/Chromakey-video-to-image) \-- it's free, but does not give excellent results automagically: you need to tweak some variables.

replies.author: Celvin_
replies.body:
I’ve tried this one. It’s good, but far from perfect. 

Even after tweaking, I still ended up with artifacts around some of the edges and some details lost on the character. You can see that on the example image as well.

replies.author: EmotionalFan5429
replies.body:
I agree. It's far from perfect, but:

1. are known background removers give better result?  
2. can you tweek the background removers?  
3. how long is the whole workflow with the background removers (split video to PNGs and proceed every image)

I've tried [https://github.com/jjb-pro/BackgroundRemover](https://github.com/jjb-pro/BackgroundRemover), background remover in Krita and on Recraft AI website -- they require 10-100x times more of manual work.

comments.author: Old-Northstrider
comments.body:
I've had this same issue for a while now so I made this small tool: [https://vid2sprite.com/](https://vid2sprite.com/)  
Completely free, runs fully in your browser and very easy to use!  
I'm actively improving/adding to it according to my own workflow and and needs but I hope someone else finds it helpful as well \^\^  
You can set your own resolution so the low resolution isn't an issue, it default to the video's resolution when you run it  
I also found myself picking an evenly spaced set of frames across a trimmed window so I made a "smart select" mode to make that easier as well
